scope: Targeted source interpretation only; no new flow amount or parameter adopted

sources.citation: Büring et al. (2024), Unveiling the wasp-waist structure of the Falkland shelf ecosystem
findings: Discards is a separate prey category for scavengers; its biomass is defined from the total 2020 fishery discards.
Bird consumption of vessel waste includes fish guts and heads.
The inspected material does not quantify an additional processing-offal flow that closes the reconstructed supply deficit.

sources.citation: Kuepfer et al., online 2022 / volume 2023, Prey-switching to fishery discards does not compensate for poor natural foraging conditions in breeding albatross
sources.version: Publisher PDF in authors' institutional repository, with repository cover sheet
locators: Printed p.2 / PDF p.3: fleet characteristics
Printed p.4 / PDF p.5: annual indices of prey availability
findings: Finfish fleets release unwanted fish and processing offal from commercial fish.
The study estimates relative discard availability using commercial catches, assuming proportionality, particularly for offal.
This supports checking whether the Ecopath discard ledger and bird-food definition cover the same material; it does not supply an independently measured annual offal input for this model.

sources.citation: User Guide for Ecopath with Ecosim: Ecopath Input
findings: Fleet discard fate and natural detritus fate are distinct inputs.
Unrouted surplus detritus is exported; a dedicated discard pool needs its own incoming discard route.
For surplus-fate fractions summing to less than one, detritus Export is calculated as InputToDet minus DetEaten, BA, DetPassedOn and Resp.
This explains how an unsupplied consumed pool can have a negative calculated Export. It is not evidence of an observed external import.

interpretation: The source-stored negative Export and the reconstruction's negative BA describe matching closure deficits through different fields. Explicit fleet returns must still be restored separately and cannot be inferred from that negative Export.
